# SLR Assistant

> Local-first, open-source, AI-assisted software for systematic and scoping literature review workflows.

Short description:
SLR Assistant helps researchers import references, deduplicate records, screen titles and abstracts, process full-text PDFs, extract structured data, and export auditable review outputs. It supports a desktop GUI and a local browser WebApp. Human verification is required.

## Key Resources

* Landing page: https://sadeghanisi.github.io/SLR/

## Important Context

* Local-first single-user research tool.
* The WebApp runs on localhost and is not intended for public multi-user deployment.
* Cloud LLM providers receive submitted paper text through their APIs.
* Router providers such as OpenRouter add an additional third party before the final model provider.
* Ollama and other local model endpoints are the most privacy-preserving option.
* The tool supports PRISMA-aligned workflows, but does not guarantee PRISMA compliance.
* Researchers remain responsible for final inclusion/exclusion decisions, extracted data verification, and methodological reporting.

## Keywords
